sloka: गच्छ सौम्य द्विजश्रेष्ठं समाश्वासय सुव्रतम् ।बालस्य तु शरीरं तत्तैलद्रोण्यां निधापय ।। ७.७५.२ ॥
transliteration: gaccha saumya dvijaśreṣṭhaṁ samāśvāsaya suvratam ।bālasya tu śarīraṁ tattailadroṇyāṁ nidhāpaya ।। 7.75.2 ॥

translations.english: O gentle one, go and console that best of Brahmins, the one of good vows, and have the child's body preserved in a trough of oil.
